a 0.9% YoY decline in total passenger traffic to 7.87M in August 2026.
Domestic passenger traffic fell 7.4%, while international traffic rose 4.5% and transit traffic increased 10.4%.
Argentina’s passenger traffic declined 5.3%, primarily due to an 8.4% drop in domestic traffic amid lower airline capacity.
Armenia recorded the strongest growth at 14.1% YoY, while Italy, Brazil, Uruguay, and Ecuador also posted passenger-traffic growth.
Year-to-date passenger traffic increased 2.4% to 58.29M passengers through August 2026.
Cargo volume declined 1.8% YoY in August to 29,357 tons, while aircraft movements fell 3.5% to 75,333.
The company said resilient international demand helped offset weaker domestic traffic, particularly in Argentina and Brazil.

title: Corporación América Airports reports 0.9% passenger traffic decline in August
